marker.step_source:
import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch.  Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# ChangeSpec name -> branch name conversion.
is_changespec = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_changespec:
        # ChangeSpec ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

## What landed

**sase-core (Rust)** — `snoozed` as a real task-bead status:
- `StatusWire::Snoozed`, `BeadSnoozeWire` (`until`, `snoozed_at`, `snoozed_by`, optional `plus_one_target`/`plus_one_baseline`, `reason`), `IssueWire::snooze`, and full `validate()` rules (task-only, record-iff-status, RFC-3339 `until` with offset, target strictly above baseline, non-blank actor/timestamp).
- `snooze_task` / `cancel_task_snooze` / `wake_due_task_snoozes`. The wake selector is read-only by design — the status only changes when the human answers the gate.
- `add_task_plus_one` gained a snoozed branch: below target stays snoozed (suppressing the old `Open|Closed -> Ready` promotion), at target wakes to `Ready` with the preset attributed note.
- `TaskSnoozed` / `TaskSnoozeCanceled` / `TaskSnoozeWoken` events with reducer replay, `snooze` carried through jsonl/read/search, a snoozed-status SQLite migration, and pyo3 bindings.

**sase (Python)** — `Status.SNOOZED`, a frozen `SnoozeRecord`, a shared `snooze_codec`, the mirror schema + migration, the grey-diamond presentation entry between `ready` and `in_progress`, and the hard-coded status-list consumers (`cli_query` stats, `cli_dep_render`, Artifacts beads pane/filter bar, doctor, status cycle) plus `BeadProject`/facade methods.

## Verification
- sase-core: all `cargo test` suites pass, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` clean. Clippy needs `PYO3_PYTHON` pointed at the workspace venv — the default `python3` on PATH is 3.11 and the `abi3-py312` feature rejects it.
- sase: `just check` green. The Justfile change escalated the scoped lane to the full suite, so this was full-suite coverage (26533 passed).

Two pre-existing tests asserted invariants my migration changes, and I updated both: `_assert_columns_survive_rebuild` (the snoozed rebuild copies the modern column list, so it restores declared column order rather than leaving `close_history` appended), and the claimed-status stats assertion (now includes the `Snoozed` row).

No follow-up items were discovered. The parent epic `sase-gn` remains open.
